description: Comprehensive debloat rules for Transsion smartphone brands: Tecno (HiOS), Infinix (XOS), and Itel. Covers Palm Store, AHA Games, Carlcare, Hi Party, lockscreen ads, app recommendations, telemetry, browsers, themes, and other HiOS/XOS bloatware.

rules.name: Palm Store (Transsion Phone Store)
rules.description: Transsion's proprietary app store (Palm Store). Preloaded with ads and auto-downloaded app recommendations. Safe to disable when using Google Play Store.

rules.name: Palm Store (alternate package)
rules.description: Alternate package name for the Transsion Palm Store app store.

rules.name: AHA Games
rules.description: Transsion AHA Games preloaded game service with promotional content and ad recommendations.

rules.name: Carlcare
rules.description: Transsion official service / repair centre app (Carlcare). Optional; keep if you use Transsion warranty service.

rules.name: Hi Party
rules.description: Transsion Hi Party social/party feature. Optional preloaded OEM app.

rules.name: Lockscreen Magazine
rules.description: Aggressive lockscreen ad/promo service that pushes ads and sponsored content to the lockscreen.

rules.name: Transsion Theme Service
rules.description: Transsion theme/wallpaper service bundled with promotional wallpapers and ads.

rules.name: Phone Master / Security
rules.description: Transsion phone manager/security app with ad notifications and app recommendations.

rules.name: App Recommendation Service
rules.description: System service that pushes recommended app install notifications and promotional popups.

rules.name: Transsion Ads Framework
rules.description: Transsion advertising framework delivering system-level ads and promos across HiOS/XOS.

rules.name: Transsion Telemetry
rules.description: Transsion telemetry / usage-data collection service reporting device and app usage.

rules.name: Transsion Browser
rules.description: Preloaded Transsion web browser with sponsored bookmarks, trending content ads, and search tracking.

rules.name: Transsion Theme Store
rules.description: Storefront for purchasing wallpapers, ringtones, lockscreens, and system fonts. Optional.

rules.name: Phone Manager
rules.description: Transsion phone cleaner/manager app bundled with promotional notifications.

rules.name: Game Assistant
rules.description: Transsion gaming mode / game assistant overlay. Optional feature.

rules.name: Transsion Notepad
rules.description: Preloaded Transsion notes app. Optional; safe to remove if using another notes app.

rules.name: Transsion Recorder
rules.description: Preloaded Transsion voice recorder app. Optional feature.

rules.name: Transsion Calendar
rules.description: OEM calendar app bundled with promotional content. Optional if using Google Calendar.

rules.name: Transsion File Manager
rules.description: Transsion file manager app. Optional; safe to remove if using Google Files.

rules.name: Transsion Music
rules.description: Preloaded Transsion music player with ads and promotional content.

rules.name: Transsion Weather
rules.description: OEM weather app bundled with ads and location-based promotions.

rules.name: Itel Smart Panel
rules.description: Itel OEM smart panel/assistant app bundled with recommendations and ads.

rules.name: Infinix Ad Service
rules.description: Infinix XOS ad delivery service pushing promotional notifications.

rules.name: Tecno HiOS Center
rules.description: Tecno HiOS system center/feature app. Optional OEM preload.

rules.name: Transsion OTA Update
rules.description: Transsion system OTA update client. Extreme removal only — disabling prevents system updates.

rules.name: Transsion Global Service
rules.description: Transsion global framework service associated with regional telemetry and promos.

rules.name: Keyboard Manager
rules.description: Transsion keyboard manager bundled with promotional content and ad suggestions.

rules.name: Transsion Voice Assistant
rules.description: OEM voice assistant feature. Optional preload.

rules.name: Transsion Wallet
rules.description: Transsion wallet/payment app. Optional OEM financial feature.
